ownerWords:

goal: A customer who calls api.virev.ai never hits a dead portal or a dead crawler behind it. The prod checks of the portal docs, crawler /health and crawler /health/schema pass all day, pass now, and still run every 5 min.

metrics.label: Prod uptime of api.virev.ai and its crawler, last 24 h

onMiss: Read the flagged rows. crawler_health or crawler_schema means the crawler behind the portal; portal_openapi means api.virev.ai. Follow ops/runbooks/api-portal-probe-down.md in auto-sns-agent, or api-portal-probe-stale.md for a stale probe, a series_missing or a source_error row (check the Convex cron "api health probe" and the api-portal-health scrape first). A portal outage gets one fix job here unless one is live; it fixes on staging (c50) and asks the chat for any prod promote. A crawler outage: name the crawler chat 01a115e2 job that owns it, or start one fix job for it, with the target, error class and time. A past failure that recovered still misses the 24 h uptime: find when and why from api_probe_up, and start one fix job for its cause unless one is live. No outside sends (c37), no merges (c49). Tell the owner when a prod target is down now. All on target: end the turn with no message.
